audience: developers and sysadmins who monitor cron jobs and scheduled tasks with Dead Man's Snitch

useCases.title: Find monitors that are failing or late
useCases.text: The AI lists snitches with their status (pending, healthy, failed, errored, paused), interval, alert type, tags and last check-in. You see which jobs need attention.

useCases.title: Look at the details of one monitor
useCases.text: The AI opens one snitch with its full details, including its check-in URL. The URL is a secret, so share it with care.

useCases.title: Create a monitor for a new scheduled job
useCases.text: The AI creates a new snitch and returns its check-in URL, which the job must call on every run. It fails when the plan's snitch limit is reached.

useCases.title: Pause or unpause a monitor during maintenance
useCases.text: The AI pauses a snitch, which silences its alerts, with a setting for when alerting resumes, or unpauses it. A job that stops while paused goes unnoticed.

useCases.title: Change a monitor or sort monitors with tags
useCases.text: The AI changes a snitch's fields, such as alert email recipients, and adds or removes tags. You can group monitors, for example backups.
